integrity: The all-n proof is algebraic. The bundled verifier independently checks closed-form deck coordinates by direct subsequence enumeration, exhaustively classifies all weight-3 words through length 35, and checks the collision generating-function coefficients through length 50. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is specific to binary length-3 subsequence decks restricted to words of Hamming weight 3. It does not determine the unrestricted quantity D_3(n), higher fixed weights, or larger deck lengths.
title: The weight-three binary 3-deck generating function
